# Project artwork

Created with built-in image generation. Conceptual illustrations, not product screenshots.

## mood.png

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portfolio project card illustration, square composition, detailed high-quality image. Mood & Mental Health Risk Detection: machine learning analyzes TEXT AND AUDIO for emotional states. A beautifully designed laptop with a large glowing audio waveform and three simple chat bubbles on its screen; nearby four small ceramic face tokens showing distinct happy, neutral, sad and worried expressions connected by subtle light trails. Warm empathetic scientific mood, no medical diagnoses, no hospital symbols. Style: refined stylized animated-film illustration with subtly faceted geometry and richly crafted materials, not photoreal people. Cohesive palette: deep slate blue background, warm amber lantern-like key light, cream details, restrained teal highlights. Quiet intimate wooden desk environment, cinematic shadows, clean visual hierarchy, central objects fully visible with generous safe margins for slightly landscape card crop. Project subject must be unmistakable at thumbnail size. No towns, portals, castles, or character portraits. No readable text, letters, numbers, brand logos, watermarks or borders. This is a conceptual illustration, not an actual product screenshot.
